info.title: Opanel API
info.description: Opanel is an open-source project management tool for human teams and AI agents.

get.description: Reports whether the service can reach its database. Requires no credentials.

200.description: The service and its database are available.

get.description: This document: the OpenAPI 3.1 description of the Opanel API.

post.description: Signs a person in with email and password and sets the session cookie. Public: it cannot require credentials. A wrong password, an unknown email and a deactivated account are answered identically. Must come from the app's own origin.

200.description: Signed in. The session cookie is set.

403.description: The request does not come from the app's own origin.

post.description: Ends the current session and clears its cookie. Needs a session, no permission.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

get.description: Returns the caller's account and permissions. Needs a session, no permission.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

patch.description: Changes the caller's name and returns the caller as `GET /api/v1/me` does. Needs a session, no permission. Must come from the app's own origin.

403.description: The request does not come from the app's own origin.

post.description: Replaces the caller's password after checking the current one, and ends every other session of the account; the session that made the request stays signed in. A wrong current password is a 400 with a field error on `currentPassword`. Limited per account. Needs a session, no permission. Must come from the app's own origin.

400.description: The body is not valid, or the current password is wrong.

403.description: The request does not come from the app's own origin.

429.description: Too many attempts for this account. See Retry-After.

post.description: First-run setup. Creates the first Admin and signs them in. Public, because before the first account exists there is nobody to authenticate. Once any account exists it answers 404, like an unknown path. Must come from the app's own origin.

201.description: The Admin was created. The session cookie is set.

403.description: The request does not come from the app's own origin.

404.description: The installation is already set up.

post.summary: Accept an invitation or reset link
post.description: Sets the password of the account a one-time link was issued for, and signs the person in. Public: the token is the credential. Every refusal (unknown, used, expired, replaced, or the account is deactivated) is the same 404 `invalid_link`. All earlier sessions of the account end. Must come from the app's own origin.

200.description: The password was set. The session cookie is set.

403.description: The request does not come from the app's own origin.

429.description: Too many attempts from this address. See Retry-After.

get.description:
Lists human accounts, oldest first, with keyset pagination.

Requires the `accounts:manage` permission.

400.description: The query string is not valid.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

post.description:
Creates an account with no password and a one-time link, valid for 7 days, that is shown only in this response. Must come from the app's own origin.

Requires the `accounts:manage` permission.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

409.description: An account with this email already exists.

patch.summary: Change an account's role or activity
patch.description:
Changes the role and/or deactivates or reactivates a human account. A role change or a deactivation ends the account's sessions at once. The only active Admin cannot be demoted or deactivated. Must come from the app's own origin.

Requires the `accounts:manage` permission.

400.description: The path or the body is not valid.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

404.description: There is no such human account.

409.description: The change would leave no active Admin (code `last_admin`).

post.summary: Issue a one-time link for an account
post.description:
For an invited account it issues a fresh invitation link, for an active one a password reset link. Earlier unused links of the account stop working. The link is shown only in this response. Must come from the app's own origin.

Requires the `accounts:manage` permission.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

404.description: There is no such human account.

delete.summary: Revoke an invitation that was never accepted
delete.description:
Removes an invited account that never set a password, with its links, so its email can be invited again. An account that has a password is refused with 409: deactivate it instead. Must come from the app's own origin.

Requires the `accounts:manage` permission.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

404.description: There is no such human account.

get.description:
Lists the people who can be assigned work or added to a team, ordered by name, with keyset pagination. Deactivated people are included with `active: false`; invited accounts that have not chosen a password are not.

Requires the `projects:read` permission.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Only people whose name starts with this text, ignoring case.

parameters.description: Only people whose name starts with this text, ignoring case.

400.description: The query string is not valid.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

post.summary: Add a person to a team
post.description:
Adding someone who is already a member changes nothing and succeeds. Only active people can be added.

Requires the `teams:manage` permission.

404.description: There is no such team, or the person is not a member.
